preferred_sources.hotpotqa: genuinely unused distractor-validation IDs; expand the runtime-only validation projection if the current 4,000-row local materialization cannot provide 1,500 IDs after exclusion
preferred_sources.2wikimultihopqa: genuinely unused IDs from the corrected dev.json
preferred_sources.musique: genuinely unused IDs from musique_ans_v1.0_train.jsonl; exclude the historical MuSiQue development IDs and every previously evaluated ID

freshness_exclusion_categories: all robustness/stress-test IDs whose outcomes were inspected
all reader-transfer IDs whose outcomes were inspected
all previous Fresh-ID evaluation IDs whose Gold/outcomes were opened
all previous Fresh extension corpus-contributor IDs from the same dataset, for the strictest primary evaluation freshness definition
any other question ID appearing in an experiment namespace whose correctness/outcome was accessed
pass_rule: PASS only if all hard-pass conditions hold and each required dataset has >=1500 genuinely unused evaluation IDs. Otherwise FAIL and stop before selecting IDs or running retrieval/generation.
stop_boundary: This audit authorizes no fresh-ID selection, retrieval, generation, V2 scoring, GbV scoring, Gold mapping, or evaluation. A subsequent protocol step is required after human review of the audit.
